evidence.CANHLIFE: Canara HSBC Life Insurance is an Indian life insurance company, headquartered in Gurugram. In 2008, Canara HSBC Life Insurance was a JV between Canara Bank (51%), HSBC Insurance (Asia Pacific) Holdings Limited (26%) and PNB (23%). In 2022, the company renamed itself as Canara HSBC Life Insurance after the exit of its third partner, PNB. Business Profile Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited is a bank-led private life insurer jointly promoted by Canara Bank (51%) and HSBC Insurance. The company offers a comprehensive range of individual and group insurance solutions, including savings, protection, retirement, ULIPs, annuity, and government-backed schemes.
evidence.GICRE: General Insurance Corporation of India is engaged in the business of Reinsurance.(Source : 201903 Annual Report Page No:87) History - Post Independence, Government of India (GOI) took over 55 Indian insurance companies and the undertakings of 52 insurers carrying on general insurance business. Later in Nov 1972, GOI incorporated General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC) to look after the above entities which were merged into 4 companies namely, National Insurance Company Limited, The New India Assurance Company Limited, The Oriental Insurance Company Limited, United India Insurance Company Limited (which is also a wholly-owned subsidiary of GIC).
evidence.GODIGIT: Incorporated in 2016, Go Digit General Insurance Ltd provides motor, health, and other insurances Business Overview: GDGIL is a digital full stack insurance company which designs products, distributes and provides customer experience for non-life insurance products. Company offers motor insurance, health insurance, travel insurance, property insurance, marine insurance, liability insurance and other insurance products
evidence.HDFCLIFE: HDFC Life Insurance Company is engaged in carrying on the business of life insurance. The Company offers a range of individual and group insurance solutions. The portfolio comprises of various insurance and investment products such as Protection, Pension, Savings,(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No: 175) Parentage HDFC Bank, the promoter group, holds 50.25% stake as of Q2 FY26. As India’s largest private sector bank by balance sheet size, HBL and its subsidiaries offer a wide array of financial services, including non-banking financial services, insurance, asset management, and broking.
evidence.ICICIGI: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Co. Ltd is one of the leading and established private sector general insurance companies in India. It offers a well-diversified range of products and risk management solutions through multiple distribution channels. It was established in 2001 as a JV between ICICI Bank and Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd. ICICI held 64% stake and the rest was held by JV partner. Fairfax Financial exited in 2019 by selling its remaining 5% stake in the company for ~2,600 crores.
evidence.ICICILIFE: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Ltd carries on business of providing life insurance, pensions and health insurance products to individuals and groups. The business is conducted in participating, non-participating and unit linked lines of business. These products are distributed through individual agents, corporate agents, banks, brokers, sales force and company's website. It is promoted by ICICI Bank and Prudential Corporation
